archiveTitle: Daily Brief | 雨のちハレ女: Game Freak Announces Ame Nochi Hareonna

entries.headline: 雨のちハレ女: Game Freak Announces Mobile Game Ame Nochi Hareonna for This Winter
entries.summary: Game Freak has announced the free-to-play mobile game Ame Nochi Hareonna. Set in modern Japan, it follows magical girls who turn weather into magic to lift people's spirits, and is planned for iOS and Android this winter.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON, 4Gamer, and Famitsu independently support the announcement, platforms, free-to-play model, and winter release window.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight Details Mayhem Collection DLC
entries.summary: The Mayhem Collection DLC lets players control The Joker and Harley Quinn, escape Arkham, build a customizable villain hideout, and recruit a crew for repeatable Mayhem Mode runs against A.R.G.U.S. and Task Force X.
entries.verification: The first-party Xbox Wire developer article supports the characters, hideout, and mode details; the packet does not provide a release date for the DLC.
entries.timeNote: Xbox Wire's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: 人形の影：ピヨリタの物語: Ningyo no Kage: Piyorita no Monogatari Announced for PC and Consoles in 2027
entries.summary: KIWIWALKS has announced a 3D story-driven action RPG that inherits the world of the WitchSpring series and follows the doll Piyorita as she absorbs other dolls in pursuit of becoming the finished creation.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON and 4Gamer independently support the announcement, 2027 window, and PC/console scope; no specific consoles are inferred.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: SCP Foundation / V/H/S: SCP: SCP Wiki Says the V/H/S: SCP Film Team Did Not Contact It in Advance
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that after news of A24's involvement in V/H/S: SCP, the official SCP Wiki said it had received no consultation or contact from the film team and highlighted the CC BY-SA license governing the material.
entries.verification: Only AUTOMATON was opened in the packet, not the SCP Wiki statement or a studio page, so all claims remain attributed to the report.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: スーパーダンガンロンパ２×２: Super Danganronpa 2x2 Will Revise Its PC Recommended Specifications
entries.summary: According to AUTOMATON's relay of producer Shohei Sakakibara, the current PC recommendation assumes 4K high-quality settings and will be updated; he also said the Nintendo Switch version is being optimized for that platform.
entries.verification: The report directly attributes the clarification to the producer; media comparisons are not treated as facts.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Marathon Delays Its Major Update to December 8 and Shifts Toward Permanent PvE Content
entries.summary: IGN relays Bungie's announcement that the major update planned for September 22 will arrive December 8 with permanent PvE content, a social space, and an experimental TDM mode. A smaller October 6 update will reset progression and the in-game economy.
entries.verification: The update schedule is explicitly attributed to Bungie; broader speculation in the report is excluded.
entries.timeNote: IGN's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls Director Apologizes for PC Launch Issues
entries.summary: IGN reports that director Kazuto Sekine acknowledged and apologized for PC stability problems and said the team is working on improvements, including changes to input handling and balance.
entries.verification: Only statements directly quoted or clearly attributed to the director are used.
entries.timeNote: IGN's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Co-op Survival Horror Game Feed the Fire Announced
entries.summary: Magellan Tide Games has announced the first-person survival horror game Feed the Fire. Players gather resources and fortify camp by day, then defend against creatures at night, alone or with up to four players.
entries.verification: The packet opened only AUTOMATON, not a developer or store page, so the item is presented as a media relay of the announcement.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: PICROSS S CLIMAX Announced for Switch 2 and Switch on December 10
entries.summary: Jupiter has announced PICROSS S CLIMAX, compiling 1,020 selected puzzles from PICROSS S through PICROSS S9 plus 40 high-difficulty bonus puzzles unlocked through series save data.
entries.verification: The date, platforms, counts, and unlock condition are taken from AUTOMATON's relay of the announcement.

entries.headline: HORI Arcade Classic Pro for Nintendo Switch 2: HORI Announces Arcade Classic Pro Controller with Swappable Input Units
entries.summary: HORI has announced the officially licensed HORI Arcade Classic Pro for Nintendo Switch 2 for Switch 2, Switch, and PC. It supports four swappable input-unit types including a stick and trackball and is designed for the Arcade Archives series.
entries.verification: The product scope, licensing, order period, and price are taken from AUTOMATON's report of the announcement.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Rayman Legends Retold Delayed to December 3
entries.summary: IGN relays Ubisoft's announcement that Rayman Legends Retold, previously due October 1, has moved to December 3 for additional polish despite going gold. Another look is scheduled for September 22.
entries.verification: The delay, reason, and showcase date are explicitly attributed to Ubisoft.
entries.timeNote: IGN's publication time converts to Beijing time and falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: GungHo Announces 30-Player Co-op PvE Shooter B.L.U.E. NOVA
entries.summary: GungHo has announced the free-to-play online co-op PvE shooter B.L.U.E. NOVA for PC in 2027. Players can form temporary R.I.N.G. links on the battlefield and join large fights with up to 30 players.
entries.verification: The packet opened only AUTOMATON, not a first-party page, so the item remains a media relay of the announcement.

entries.summary: tinyBuild has announced Hypnohead's The Crab is Walking. Players build a settlement, produce resources, and raise an army within limited space on the back of a moving giant creature while confronting battles and events across the wasteland.
